newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish competitivity falls slightly in July.
newsitem.headline: Spanish competitivity falls slightly in July.

text.p: The competitivity of Spanish exports versus other OECD nations fell slightly in July due to the appreciation of the peseta during the summer, according to an index released by the State Secretariate for Trade.
The competitivity-price index stood at 88.1 in July, unchanged from a year ago and compared with 87.8 in June.

A statement from the secretariate predicted competitivity would fall by 0.4 percent in August to put the index at 88.5 percent in comparison with countries belonging to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD).
